testimonials.text: Short, precise, informative, specially the assessment part was amazing.
This course covers a really interesting intersection of physiology, pharmacology, and surgical technique, all critical to optimizing neurosurgical patient care.
Amazing course indeed. Very relevant for all surgeons interested in neurosurgery and surgeons in deprived settings.
I particularly appreciated the emphasis on neurophysiological stability, airway management strategies, and the importance of multidisciplinary coordination.
The anaesthesia considerations for craniotomy, especially the monitoring techniques like SSEPs and MEPs, were very useful and clinically relevant.

The balance between providing deep anesthesia and preserving accurate neurological monitoring, and how to maintain cerebral perfusion and oxygenation while allowing rapid recovery for early postoperative neurological assessment.
It provided a solid foundation in the principles and practical considerations of anesthesia for craniotomy. I appreciate the focus on safety, hemodynamic control, and cerebral protection.
